## Line 20

```plato

    // Uniformly scale about `center` by `factor` (1 leaves the shape unchanged).
    ScaleAbout(self: IDeformable2D, center: Point2D, factor: Number): Self
        => self.Deform(p => center + center.Between(p) * factor);
```
